##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 12 May 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High in the mid Atlantic, low pressure near Iceland moving east.


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6 backing west this evening, increasing northwest 5 to 7 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming moderate occasionally rough later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming more widespread later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7 on Wednesday evening, veering north-northwest 5 or 6 overnight into Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate occasionally rough becoming slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Occasional showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.
